name: __PROJECT_SLUG__
description: A browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

scripts.lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.run:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
